easyPrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that can attack this turn.
description:
Declare two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack two different opponents. Commander Liara Portyr triggers, causing spells you cast from exile this turn to cost {2} less to cast.
Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Aang
Repeat from step 3.
